entities.summary: Ilaiyaraaja is an Indian musician, composer, arranger, conductor, orchestrator, multi-instrumentalist, lyricist and playback singer popular for his works in Indian cinema, predominantly in Tamil in addition to Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi films. Regarded as one of the most prolific composers, in a career spanning over forty-nine years, he has composed over 8,600 songs, provided film scores for about 1,523 feature films in nine languages, and performed in over 20,000 concerts. He was one of the earliest Indian film composers to use Western classical music harmonies and string arrangements in Indian film music.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ilaiyaraaja's prolific career and innovative use of Western classical music harmonies in Indian film music have had a significant impact on the development of Tamil cinema, with his compositions being performed in over 20,000 concerts and featured in over 1,523 films.
